declarations.docstring: The condition that the preadditive Yoneda functor represented by an object preserves finite limits and finite colimits.
The condition that the preadditive Coyoneda functor represented by an object preserves finite limits and finite colimits.
Characterizes the Yoneda preservation condition by preservation of finite limits and finite colimits.
Characterizes the Coyoneda preservation condition by preservation of finite limits and finite colimits.
